card.fact_statement: The World Health Organization dispatched 60 tonnes of critical medical supplies to Myanmar.
card.source_span: The World Health Organization announced a dispatch of 60 tonnes of critical medical supplies, including mobile medical tents, surgical kits and medicines.

target_qa_variants.question: Welche internationale Organisation entsandte nach dem Erdbeben von 2025 60 Tonnen wichtige medizinische Hilfsgüter nach Myanmar?
target_qa_variants.source_span: The World Health Organization announced a dispatch of 60 tonnes of critical medical supplies, including mobile medical tents, surgical kits and medicines.

backtranslation_en.question: Which international organization sent 60 tons of essential medical supplies to Myanmar after the 2025 earthquake?
